segments.caption: A person cuts into a large, juicy fried chicken sandwich on a wooden board, revealing its crispy, saucy interior. The scene transitions to show the sandwich being served at Joseph Leonard's restaurant, where a customer sits at a rustic table, savoring the meal. The exterior shot of the restaurant, with a yellow taxi passing by, grounds the experience in a bustling urban setting, highlighting the sandwich as the star of the show.

A man with a beard, identified by on-screen text as Gabriel Stulman, owner of Joseph Leonard, sits at a wooden table in a rustic, warmly lit café. He is actively engaged in conversation, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize his points while looking directly at the camera. The setting features vintage decor, including ornate mirrors on the wall and a large window to his right, creating an intimate and casual atmosphere for the interview.
